title: Always-on meter card backdrop (410..870 x 0..52) paints over the HUD title and instruction line drawn before it
evidence: app/main.odin:713: draw_text(app, "Packet Plumber - v2 story 4.3 (network health + win/lose/retry)", 12, 10, 22, p.ink) | app/main.odin:776: rnd.draw_health_meter(&app.view, &app.state.health, &app.cat, app.state.health_enabled) | app/render/health.odin:33-39: card_w := i32(440) / x := (v.win_w - card_w) / 2 / y := i32(10) / rl.DrawRectangle(x - pad, y - pad, card_w + 2 * pad, HEALTH_CARD_H, rl.Color{255, 244, 236, 240}) | app/render/health.odin:19-21: draw_health_meter — the top-center meter card (clear of the top-left run HUD + the top-right forecast panel).
detail: At win_w 1280 the card backdrop spans x 410..870, y 0..52 with alpha 240. The title (63 chars, size 22, x=12) and the y=36 instruction line extend past x=410; the card is drawn after them, occluding their tails every frame when health is on.
recommended_fix: Shorten or move the title and instruction lines clear of x=410 within y 0..52, or shrink/reposition the card; the 'clear of the top-left run HUD' claim is false.

title: Shifted crisis banner (y=68) collides with the strain-legend line drawn at y=76 on top of it
evidence: app/main.odin:777-784: banner_y: i32 = 10 / if app.state.health_enabled { banner_y = 10 + rnd.HEALTH_CARD_H + 6 } / rnd.draw_crisis_banner(&app.view, &app.state.crisis, &app.cat, app.state.era, banner_y) | app/main.odin:789: draw_text(app, lead_s, 12, 76, 14, p.ink_soft) | app/render/crisis.odin:37-41: y := y_base / h := title_h + i32(rows) * line_h + pad / rl.DrawRectangle(x - pad, y - pad, card_w + 2 * pad, h, card)
detail: With health on and an active crisis the banner card spans y 58..~122, x 410..870; the legend text (y 76..90, drawn after the banner) is painted over the banner's title and redesign rows. Neither new golden captures meter+banner coexistence, so the harness never pins this frame.
recommended_fix: Move the legend line below the shifted banner or draw it above the banner; add a golden capture of the meter+banner coexistence frame (health on + active surge).
